desc_zh: 以明亮浅淡色调为主，阴影极少，明朗纯净
desc_en: Bright and light tones dominate, minimal shadows, clear and pure

desc_zh: 明暗层次丰富均衡，还原自然视觉真实感
desc_en: Balanced lighting and natural gradations, realistic and true-to-life

desc_zh: 以深重暗色调为主，高光点缀，神秘沉稳
desc_en: Deep and dark tones dominate, selective highlights, enigmatic and moody

desc_zh: 阶调过渡柔和绵密，对比微弱，温润细腻
desc_en: Gentle transitions, delicate contrast, tender and subtle

desc_zh: 明暗反差强烈，光影交界锐利，轮廓硬朗有力量
desc_en: Crisp and firm contrast, sharp light transitions, punchy and bold

desc_zh: 亮部极亮、暗部极深，冲击力强，张力十足
desc_en: Brilliant highlights and deep blacks, striking dramatic impact

desc_zh: 反差适中，层次自然过渡，舒适耐看
desc_en: Moderate contrast, rich gray gradation, comfortable and balanced

desc_zh: 明暗差异微小，灰度丰富，平和静谧
desc_en: Subtle contrast, expansive mid-tones, serene, calm, and grounded

desc_zh: 阶调分布均衡于中间灰，克制内敛，高级质感
desc_en: Centered in refined mid-grays, restrained, understated elegance

desc_zh: 空气透视感明显，烟波雾霭，诗意朦胧
desc_en: Atmospheric haze, gentle dissipation of detail, poetic and dreamy

desc_zh: 戏剧性强光影明暗交错，舞台光感，张力拉满
desc_en: Dramatic interplay of dark and light, stage-lit focus, intense storytelling

desc_zh: 强逆光曝光，勾勒主体纯黑剪影轮廓，意境深邃
desc_en: Strong backlight silhouettes the subject, stark contours, profound aura

desc_zh: 光线澄澈纯净，空气透明度高，明快清爽
desc_en: Crystal-clear lighting, ultra-high transparency, vivid, crisp and fresh

desc_zh: 经典胶片颗粒与复古调色，色彩浓郁，叙事质感
desc_en: Analogue film color science, organic grain, nostalgic cinematic warmth

desc_zh: 压低环境照度，暗调情绪弥漫，幽静深邃
desc_en: Low ambient luminosity, brooding mood, mysterious and introspective

desc_zh: 低饱和柔和灰阶，光影微澜，静谧典雅
desc_en: Low saturation soft gray grading, gentle highlights, peaceful and graceful
